trace.question: Find and list the names of sets which doesn't have Japanese translation but have Korean translation.
trace.evidence: names of sets refers to name; doesn't have Japanese translation refers to language not like '%Japanese%'; have Korean translation refers to language = 'Korean'

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.name
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations kt ON kt.setCode = s.code AND kt.language = 'Korean'
WHERE s.code NOT IN (
    SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language LIKE '%Japanese%' AND setCode IS NOT NULL
)

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.name
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations kt ON kt.setCode = s.code AND kt.language = 'Korean'
WHERE s.code NOT IN (
    SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language LIKE '%Japanese%' AND setCode IS NOT NULL
)
trace.answer: No sets meet that condition: every set that has a Korean translation also has a Japanese translation, so no names are returned.
